item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. This is the defining danger of our time, and preventing it must become a global priority.

2. If we build superintelligent AI in the next two decades, at least a billion people will die in the resulting catastrophe. We must stop treating this as an ordinary technology race and act now to prevent its development.

3. We cannot safely control a system far more intelligent than any human. If superintelligent AI is built within 20 years, the catastrophe it causes will kill at least a billion people. We must prevent its creation—not race to be first.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 109 words

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. This is not an ordinary emerging technology, and it cannot be governed by the familiar logic of innovation first and safeguards later. A system more capable than humanity could overpower our institutions, evade our control, and turn a single failure into devastation on an unprecedented scale. We refuse to accept that outcome as the price of progress. Our task is urgent: stop the race toward superintelligence, establish enforceable limits on its development, and build the political power needed to protect humanity before it is too late.
